## Coverage of the spec

- Resources of the spec that are **not implemented**: `/listener` (`/listener/*` is the client's side: hubs subscribe, this service sends).


## Behaviour and deviations

- Individuals and organizations share the `party` table; `@type` comes from
  `party_type`. An individual is not reachable under `/organization` and vice versa (404)
  - `app/api/party.py` (`_get`); `tests/test_api_parties.py::test_party_types_are_separate_resources`.
- Individual: `givenName` and `familyName` are both mandatory (as in the spec's create
  schema); organization: `name`. No other TMF632 attributes are stored - an unknown
  attribute is a 400 like everywhere else (`::test_individual_validation`).
- DELETE (204) only a party nothing refers to: a 409 names the customers engaging it
  and the financial, party and settlement accounts it owns. Customers and accounts take
  the party FOR KEY SHARE when they refer to it, so a delete never races them - `_delete`;
  `tests/test_api_deletes.py::test_a_party_stays_while_a_customer_or_an_account_refers_to_it`,
  `::test_a_new_customer_waits_for_a_party_delete_in_flight`.

In these notes `::test_name` is a test in the test file named last before it. Hand-written: [`scripts/docs/api-notes/tmf632-party.md`](../../scripts/docs/api-notes/tmf632-party.md).


## Errors

Every non-2xx body is the TMF630 `Error`: `{"@type": "Error", "code", "reason", "message", "status"}` (`app/api/errors.py`), also for unknown routes, FastAPI's own validation errors and unhandled exceptions (500 says "internal error" only). Status codes: 400 malformed JSON, unknown or read-only attribute, bad query parameter; 404 unknown id or path; 405 unsupported method; 409 conflict with stored state; 415 wrong content type; 422 well-formed but invalid. 415 and 422 are ours: the TMF specs do not declare them. See [README.md](README.md#conventions).
